These 4-inch oval side step bars fit 2017-2022 Ford F-250, F-350, F-450, and F-550 Super Duty Crew Cab trucks in a matte black finish. Heavy-duty 201 stainless steel construction mounts to the rocker panel for a stable, slip-resistant step in and out of the cab.

Highlights

  • 4-inch oval design: Wide, stable stepping surface for cab entry and exit.
  • 201 stainless steel: Heavy-duty construction for long-lasting corrosion resistance.
  • Matte black powder coat: Powder-coated finish on the stainless steel bars.
  • Rocker panel mount: Secure, factory-style installation.
  • Crew Cab specific fit: Built for models with 4 full-size doors that open the same way.

Fitment

  • 2017-2022 Ford F-250 Super Duty — Crew Cab pickup (XL, XLT, Lariat, King Ranch, Platinum; Limited 2018-2022)
  • 2017-2022 Ford F-350 Super Duty — Crew Cab pickup (XL, XLT, Lariat, King Ranch, Platinum; Limited 2018-2022)
  • 2017-2022 Ford F-450 Super Duty — Crew Cab pickup and Crew Cab cab & chassis
  • 2017-2022 Ford F-550 Super Duty — Crew Cab cab & chassis

Fits Crew Cab models with 4 full-size doors that open the same way.

Enter your vehicle at the top of the page to confirm fit.

Installation

Rocker panel mount installation.

Warranty

Covered by Stehlen's lifetime structural warranty on the step bar frame, mounting brackets, and load-bearing welds for the original purchaser, plus a 5-year finish warranty against rust-through, peeling, or fading on the matte black finish. Details: stehlenauto.com/legal/warranty

Specifications

  • Part Number: SBHD-F15015CC-4-20-CH
  • Brand: Stehlen Auto
  • Material: 201 Stainless Steel
  • Finish/Color: Matte Black
  • Step Size: 4 in. oval
  • Mount Type: Rocker Panel
  • Warranty: Lifetime structural, 5-year finish
